Configuring workers

The crawler runs two worker pools, fetch and index. Each pool reads its size from the configuration file at start-up.

Sharding

Workers claim shards from a queue rather than from a single counter, because one counter becomes a hot spot once a pool grows past a few dozen threads.

workers:
  fetch: 16
  index: 4
  lease_seconds: 30

The lease_seconds value bounds how long a shard stays claimed when a worker dies mid-run.

A lease that is too short re-fetches shards, and one that is too long stalls the queue.

Verifying the change

  1. Restart the crawler with the new file.
  2. Watch the queue depth for one minute.
  3. Confirm that the lease column of the shard table keeps moving.

If the queue depth does not fall, the fetch pool is bound by the network rather than by the workers.
